actual_model.meaning: the model that answered, which is not always the one requested

application.meaning: the application that made it, distinct from the person

correlation_id.meaning: ties this record to the request that produced it

cost_micros.meaning: cost in millionths of a currency unit, for external providers

error_class.meaning: how it failed, if it failed; a failed request is still a use

latency_seconds.meaning: wall time to complete the request

logical_name.meaning: the name the client asked for, as exposed to applications

occurred_at.meaning: when the request was served, UTC

provider.meaning: what served it, such as a local runtime or an external API

queue_seconds.meaning: time spent waiting before work began

requested_model.meaning: the model the client asked for, when it named one

route_reason.meaning: why this route was chosen, which is what makes routing auditable

service_id.meaning: the platform service that handled it

team_id.meaning: the team scope it was made under

ttft_seconds.meaning: time to first token, where the runtime reports it

action.meaning: what was attempted, as a stable dotted name such as 'model.install'

approval_id.meaning: the administrator approval that authorized it, for actions that require one

correlation_id.meaning: ties this entry to the request or operation that caused it

occurred_at.meaning: when the action was attempted, UTC

outcome.meaning: how it ended; a permitted action can still fail or be cancelled

reason.meaning: why it was denied, or why it failed; the explanation an administrator needs and cannot reconstruct later

target_kind.meaning: what sort of thing was acted on

assumptions.meaning: what the provider assumed, so a reader can judge whether it holds here

confidence.meaning: how much weight this evidence carries

evidence_type.meaning: whether this was derived or measured

host_fingerprint.meaning: the host shape it applies to; evidence is not portable across shapes

host_memory_bytes.meaning: system memory required to load and serve

kv_cache_bytes_per_token.meaning: accelerator memory per token of context, which is what makes context length a capacity question rather than a setting

max_context_tokens.meaning: largest context the provider believes fits

model_ref.meaning: which model this concerns, by identifier

provenance.meaning: which provider produced it, when, at what version

runtime_overhead_bytes.meaning: accelerator memory the runtime itself holds

runtime_version.meaning: the runtime version the estimate assumes

total_memory_bytes.meaning: the provider's total, which may differ from the sum of its parts

weights_bytes.meaning: accelerator memory held by model weights

claim.meaning: what is claimed, as a generic name such as 'advanced_routing' or 'hosts'

entitlement_kind.meaning: whether this unlocks a capability or bounds a quantity

grace_until.meaning: how long the claim still holds after lapsing, so that a lost connection never interrupts production

granted_until.meaning: when the grant lapses; absent means perpetual

limit.meaning: the bound for a capacity claim; absent for a feature claim, unresolved when the grant is unreadable rather than unlimited

code.meaning: stable error code; never renamed once shipped

context.meaning: structured detail naming what failed and where

retryable.meaning: whether an identical retry could succeed

correlation_id.meaning: identifier tying this event to the request or operation that caused it

event_type.meaning: what happened, as a stable dotted name such as 'workload.admitted'

occurred_at.meaning: when it happened, timezone-aware UTC; never the time it was recorded

payload.meaning: the domain-specific body, itself a versioned contract

confidence.meaning: how much weight this quantity carries

effective_bytes.meaning: reported corrected for real usability; still never authorizes

provenance.meaning: who produced it, when, under which policy

reported_bytes.meaning: what the source claims; may be displayed, never authorizes

safe_bytes.meaning: effective minus protected headroom; the only layer that may authorize

observed_at.meaning: when the value was produced, UTC

policy_version.meaning: the policy version the value was derived under; a fact outlives it

producer.meaning: the module or provider that produced the value

producer_version.meaning: the producer's version, so a value can be reproduced or distrusted

unified_memory.meaning: whether this device shares the system memory pool

accelerators.meaning: every accelerator, per device and never aggregated

execution.meaning: how workloads can be run here

fingerprint.meaning: digest of the stable facts; the key by which cached evidence is later judged reusable

docker.meaning: whether a usable Docker daemon is present

unified_with_accelerator.meaning: whether system and accelerator memory are one pool

free_bytes.meaning: free space as reported; may be displayed, never authorizes

mount_point.meaning: path at which the filesystem is mounted

loopback_address.meaning: address the control plane binds to

occupied_ports.meaning: ports already in use, so the platform does not collide with them

virtualized.meaning: whether this is a virtual machine; unknown is common and honest

correlation_id.meaning: ties this authorization to the request that prompted it

on_behalf_of.meaning: the principal an application is acting for, when it is acting for one

team_ids.meaning: teams whose scope this request may draw on

display_name.meaning: name shown to an administrator; never used for authorization

external_ref.meaning: identity in the upstream provider, kept verbatim for reconciliation

principal_kind.meaning: what sort of principal this is

address.meaning: host or address the instance is bound to

base_path.meaning: path prefix the runtime serves under

port.meaning: port the instance is bound to

access_policy_ref.meaning: the policy governing who may use it, by identifier

configuration_version.meaning: advances when the serving configuration changes, so a restart can tell a stale instance from a current one

context_length_tokens.meaning: configured context length, which is a capacity decision not a setting

endpoint.meaning: where it is reachable, once it is

health.meaning: whether the API functions, as distinct from status

lifecycle_state.meaning: what the platform intends and observes

platform_max_concurrent_requests.meaning: the gateway's limit for this instance, a different dimension from runtime concurrency

reachable.meaning: whether the port answers; a reachable port is not a working API

reservation_id.meaning: the resources held for it; absent means nothing is held

runtime.meaning: the inference runtime adapter serving it

runtime_concurrency.meaning: simultaneous requests this instance is configured to handle

started_at.meaning: when it began serving; absent until it does

content_location.meaning: where the content lives; a reference, because content need not be copied into the platform to be indexed

external_id.meaning: its identity in the source, kept verbatim

media_type.meaning: content type; unknown means unclassified, not plain text

modified_at.meaning: when the source last changed it

owner_ref.meaning: who owns it in the source, by the source's own reference

path.meaning: location within the source, where the source has paths

permission_ref.meaning: pointer to the source's authorization for this item, so permissions are revalidated rather than copied and left to go stale

capabilities.meaning: what this connector can actually do, so the retrieval path never assumes a capability the source lacks

connector.meaning: the connector adapter that reaches it

indexing_state.meaning: whether it can currently be retrieved from

last_indexed_at.meaning: when the index was last rebuilt

permission_model.meaning: how authorization for this source is determined

checksum.meaning: integrity digest; absence means the bytes are unverified, not sound

download_bytes.meaning: transfer size as stated upstream; frequently absent

installed_bytes.meaning: size once written to a pool, which is not the transfer size

model_id.meaning: the model these bytes are for

pool_id.meaning: the pool holding them; absent while the artifact is still remote

revision.meaning: the immutable revision these bytes came from

artifact_id.meaning: the stored bytes, once there are any

derivation.meaning: how it was derived from that parent

last_used_at.meaning: when it last served a request, for portfolio decisions later

managed_bytes.meaning: storage this model occupies under platform management; unknown must never be summed as zero

parent_model_id.meaning: the model this was derived from, for a derived artifact

pool_id.meaning: the pool holding them, once there is one

state.meaning: where the model is in its lifecycle here

commercial_use_restricted.meaning: whether the licence restricts commercial use; unknown is not permission

context_length_tokens.meaning: maximum context the model supports; frequently absent upstream

family.meaning: model family, where the source states one

license_id.meaning: licence identifier as stated by the source

logical_name.meaning: normalized platform name, distinct from the minted identity and from the upstream reference

source.meaning: which source adapter this came from

source_revision.meaning: immutable revision; an acquisition without one is not reproducible

confidence.meaning: how much weight this requirement carries

peak_additional_bytes.meaning: most additional storage needed at any moment during acquisition, including staging and conversion; admission is against this

ram_bytes.meaning: system memory needed to load and serve

required_compute_features.meaning: compute capabilities the model needs, such as a quantization kernel

vram_kv_bytes_per_token.meaning: accelerator memory per token of context

vram_overhead_bytes.meaning: accelerator memory held by the runtime

effective_at.meaning: when this version took effect, UTC

policy_id.meaning: which policy, as a stable dotted name such as 'capacity.headroom'

version.meaning: policy version; a decision is reproducible only against the same one

accelerator_index.meaning: which device the accelerator memory is held on; absent for workloads that need none

admitted_vram_bytes.meaning: accelerator memory granted, on the device named below

host_id.meaning: the host whose resources are held

released_at.meaning: when the grant ended; absent while it is still held

state.meaning: where this reservation is in its life

workload_id.meaning: the workload it was granted to

host_id.meaning: the host it would run on

model_id.meaning: the model it serves, for workload types that have one

priority.meaning: relative importance; higher wins when capacity is contested

workload_type.meaning: what sort of work it is

correlation_id.meaning: identifier tying this outcome to the request that caused it

payload.meaning: the operation's rendered output, absent on failure

fingerprint.meaning: digest of mount identity, filesystem type and quota identity; evidence is keyed on this and is invalid when it changes

generation.meaning: advances on every successful mutation, invalidating earlier evidence

host_id.meaning: the host this pool belongs to

mount_point.meaning: path at which the pool's filesystem is mounted

provider_class.meaning: what backs the pool, which governs whether its evidence is reusable

quota_identity.meaning: the quota this pool is bounded by, where one applies; a quota failure bounds capacity differently from a disk-full failure

location.meaning: where the record is, relative to the store root

problem.meaning: why it could not be loaded

record_kind.meaning: the kind it claimed to be, when that much was readable

defects.meaning: records that could not be loaded, reported rather than skipped

swept_temporaries.meaning: interrupted writes cleaned up; each was an orphan, never a record

provenance_refs.meaning: where the material came from, by identifier, so a derived model's sources remain traceable

retention_days.meaning: how long the material may be kept

scope_team_id.meaning: the team whose material this is, which bounds what may be derived from it

training_authorized.meaning: explicit permission to train on this material; never inferred from permission to read it

derivation_type.meaning: how it was derived; an adapter is not a base model

parent_model_id.meaning: the model it was derived from

parent_revision.meaning: the parent revision it was derived from; without this the derivation is not reproducible

snapshot_id.meaning: the training material used, for derivations that used any
